name: gui_assets_watch_verify
description: HW-2s / AV-1s, from Blank with the GUI only. File > New Project > Blank; the Assets dock (View > Assets) lists the template's assets/. The textures folder's Reload when saved outside writes project.json's hot_reload through edit_project_settings, and the engine watches it at once (get_status.reload.watch). Track asset contents declares the store main at assets/ with assets.manifest.json in one edit; the engine writes the manifest and checks against it: nothing differs. A texture baked outside Studio (gui_assets_watch_verify.prepare.py) is saved into assets/textures; the engine reads it again and the line above the tree names it; Verify again finds one extra file; Update manifest says how many files change, writes the manifest, and the check is clean again. Undo takes back Track asset contents, then the watch: project.json's two keys are gone again.
